notes: State expectations come from games/trace-blade/tests/model.py, which follows the upstream JR-100 assembly (jr100dev games/trace_blade 1.6.1, no Python rules module), not from the emulator. Routes are the upstream levels.json solutions. synthetic-self-test runs every fixture of tests/selftest.py and cuts all thirty rooms inside the program without drawing; synthetic-ten-rooms plays rooms 1-10 at normal speed (all thirty would pass the runner cycle limit). Moves are 130000 cycles apart; a cut leaves 135000 cycles per path step and 290000 per target burst. synthetic-title, synthetic-menu-cut and synthetic-first-clear require a PCM peak of 21000.
